name: org.wardenprotocol/token-terminal
title: Warden Token Terminal
description: Read the token market, then prepare or execute swaps for a connected wallet.

remotes.name: Product MCP: market data, quotes, wallet and swaps

authentication.note: Market tools need no credential. Wallet tools need OAuth sign-in or a wk_ key as a bearer token.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Chains Warden supports, with each chain’s native coin, dollar stable and gasless support.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for a token, and how far it sits from its recent high and low.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find tokens by name, ticker or address.

tools.name: trending_tokens
tools.description: Trending, new or top tokens on a chain.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Price a swap without committing to it.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: The wallet the key belongs to and every token it holds on every chain, with USD values.

tools.name: agent_permissions
tools.description: What the key may do, whether a session is open, budget left.

tools.name: prepare_swap
tools.description: Build a swap for the person to sign. Never broadcasts.

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Sign and send a swap from the wallet with nobody present. Native coin, gasless and cross-chain included; on Solana, from the agent Solana wallet.

tools.name: request_session
tools.description: Ask the person to turn on hands-free trading: returns a link they approve with one tap.

tools.name: session_request_status
tools.description: Whether the person approved a request_session yet.

tools.name: swap_status
tools.description: Where a gasless (relayed) or cross-chain (bridged) trade stands, or an unconfirmed Solana swap.

relatedServers.name: Warden docs MCP
relatedServers.status: confirm URL once the docs MCP is live

sandbox.note: Market tools need no credential and move no funds.
